newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin sets 1-yr bond auction on May 27.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin sets 1-yr bond auction on May 27.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry will auction an unspecified tranche of one-year state bonds on May 27, the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said in a statement on Wednesday.
They will carry a fixed annual coupon of 10.00 percent.
The ministry does not announce the amount of state bonds and its Treasury bills on offer at auctions. Also, it does not set minimum or maximum prices for bids.
The average yield at the last successful auction of one-year state bonds on March 25 rose to 14.88 percent from 14.66 percent at the previous auction of similar bonds on February 25.
Ministry officials were not immediately available to comment on levels at which they expected banks to submit bids in the auction.

The ministry uses state bonds and T-bills as the main means to cover the budget deficit, which totalled 3.45 billion crowns in first quarter 1997, compared with a shortfall of 361.3 million crowns in first two months of this year. -- Bratislava Newsroom, 421-7-521-8402
